targets.authors: Poliseno L, Salmena L, Zhang J, Carver B, Haveman WJ, Pandolfi PP
targets.title: A coding-independent function of gene and pseudogene mRNAs regulates tumour biology
targets.evidence_quote: As part of the Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology we published a Registered Report (Khan et al., 2015), that described how we intended to replicate selected experiments from the paper "A coding-independent function of gene and pseudogene mRNAs regulates tumour biology" (Poliseno et al., 2010). Here we report the results.
targets.outcome_quote: Further, depletion of PTEN and/or PTENP1 increased DU145 proliferation compared to non-targeting siRNA, which was in the same direction as the original study (Figure 2F; Poliseno et al., 2010), but not statistically significant. We found PTEN 3'UTR overexpression in DU145 cells did not impact PTENP1 expression, while the original study reported PTEN 3'UTR increased PTENP1 levels (Figure 4A; Poliseno et al., 2010). Overexpression of PTEN 3'UTR also statistically decreased DU145 proliferation compared to controls, which was similar to the findings reported in the original study (Figure 4A; Poliseno et al., 2010).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly compare both agreeing and nonagreeing findings against the same original; no overall confirmation or failure verdict overrides these comparisons.
